question: What temporal limit and conclusion apply to other sacred observances?
premises: The period extends up to bhuta-ashtami.
For others, the observance follows their own sacred-place conclusion.
inference: Other observances end at bhuta-ashtami or at the conclusion of their respective sacred places.
uncertainties: The exact referent of anyeṣāṃ is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: For others, the observance lasts until the eighth day of the dark fortnight or until the conclusion of their own sacred place.
